overview:
Dr. Fowler is an epidemiologist focused on the overlap between cancer and geriatrics / aging. Her career goal involves working with interdisciplinary teams investigating and implementing evidence-based strategies for advancing health equity in cancer outcomes among older adults across the cancer continuum with specific focus on rural and urban health disparities. 

Dr. Fowler has conducted research with a variety of data sources including "big" data, observational data, clinical trial data, and clinical / electronic health record data to evaluate geriatric outcomes among older adults with cancer including: cognitive impairment/decline, functional impairment, and frailty. She has also evaluated differences in cancer-related mortality and geriatric outcomes by geography and social determinants of health.
